title: Dual gravities from entanglement entropy
summary: We study how entanglement entropy can be used to reconstruct a dual gravity description. For a two-dimensional thermal system, equal-time entanglement entropy determines the spatial part of a three-dimensional black-hole geometry within a given metric ansatz. For an undeformed conformal field theory, the same inverse problem can be solved analytically by the Abel transformation. For a relevant deformation, we work in three-dimensional Einstein gravity with one canonical scalar field whose profile is monotonic.
